name: SIRE_NAME
_instructions: Copy this file to <name>.json and fill in each locus with the sire's two alleles from his Embark (or other) coat color DNA report. Allele spellings: E locus: Em/Eg/E/e; K: KB/ky; A: ay/aw/at/a; B: B/b; D: D/d; Cocoa: N/co; SaddleTan: N/I; S: S/sp; M: M/m (use M for any merle allele incl. cryptic); H: H/h. Delete this key when done.
